replies.text: We actually have a video about Sweden on our channel too! ❤️ Now that we know you’re watching from there, we’d really love to know if we managed to capture the beauty of your country. If you get a chance, give it a watch and let us know what you think! 😊

comments.author: @TravelBeyond4K
comments.text: That ferocious Patagonian wind and relentless climate really show who is in charge down there! The granite spires of Torres del Paine rising over massive icefields look completely unforgiving yet breathtakingly vast. It is absolute wilderness in its purest, most brutal form.
